exploit_name: Multi-step campaign overrides anchored to original campaign prevent sequential adjustments
description: overrideCampaign() validates new overrides against original campaign parameters, not previously stored overrides. Constrains all subsequent overrides to original campaign's temporal boundaries.
root_cause: overrideCampaign() validates new overrides against original campaign parameters, not previously stored overrides. Constrains all subsequent overrides to original campaign's temporal boundaries.
fix_description: Validate against effective campaign parameters (stored overrides if they exist, otherwise original).
notes: Creators cannot make multiple sequential adjustments to campaigns.
